caption: AI drafts can look polished yet hide errors. This carousel delivers a practical five-prompt audit to verify accuracy, clarity, and bias. What draft will you audit first? #AI #Productivity #BusinessAI

slides.title: Stop trusting AI drafts
slides.body: AI can miscite, hallucinate, or omit sources. Here are five prompts to audit and fix AI work.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose accuracy
slides.body: Given {DRAFT} and {SOURCES}, list factual claims with citations and a confidence score.

slides.title: 2. Improve clarity
slides.body: Rewrite the draft for clarity and brevity; preserve meaning; show before/after.

slides.title: 3. Apply to document
slides.body: Annotate the draft with issue tags (fact, bias, tone) and suggested fixes.

slides.title: 4. Check bias and licensing
slides.body: Flag potential bias and licensing risks, propose neutral alternatives and attribution steps.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Provide a reusable QA checklist for future drafts; include success criteria.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: A five-prompt audit makes AI drafts reliable, sourced outputs you can trust.
